lessons.titleEn: regain a little more genuine human contact
lessons.titleZh: 重新增加一點真切的人際交流

target.pattern: \bregain(?:s|ed|ing)? a little more genuine human contact\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A screen-free evening can help families regain a little more genuine human contact.
sources.expression: regain a little more genuine human contact

brief.meaningEn: Recover a modest amount of personal interaction that the speaker values as direct and meaningful.
brief.meaningZh: 重新增加少量說話者認為直接而有意義的人際交流。
brief.grammar: regain a little more genuine human contact; regain implies recovering something diminished, while a little more limits the degree. Explain what genuine means in this particular account.
brief.register: Natural reflective wording, not a fixed idiom or proof that online relationships are inauthentic. Contact can be meaningful through different channels and access needs vary.
brief.boundaryZh: 真切是情境中的評價，不可把所有網上交流說成虛假；a little more也不等於完全恢復。
brief.misconceptionZh: 應有先前減少及今次恢復的線索，不單憑停用螢幕推已加深關係。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體互動支持有限的恢復，兼顧不同交流方式。

listening.promptZh: 這次恢復具體表現在哪裏？

options.en: They began talking about their lives again, beyond the collection arrangements.
options.zh: 他們再次談彼此生活，不只談收件安排。

options.en: They had already been sharing the same personal stories regularly before the lunches began.
options.zh: 午餐開始前，他們已經常分享同樣的個人近況。

options.en: The lunches replaced collection messages with a new set of written delivery instructions.
options.zh: 午餐把收件訊息換成一套新的書面送件指示。

options.en: They stopped exchanging messages but had not yet begun spending time together.
options.zh: 他們停止交換訊息，但尚未開始相處。

listening.explanationZh: 再次問生活是具體交流；不只是換安排方式，也不是尚未相處。
listening.en: Since their shifts changed, the neighbours had mostly exchanged collection messages; the weekly shared lunch helped them regain a little more genuine human contact, as they began asking about each other’s lives again.
listening.zh: 輪班時間改變後，鄰居大多只交換收件訊息；每周共進午餐讓他們重新增加一點真切交流，開始再次關心彼此的生活。

reply.promptEn: Why have the shared lunches mattered to the neighbours?
reply.promptZh: 共進午餐為甚麼對鄰居有意義？

options.en: They now ask about each other’s lives instead of only organising collections.
options.zh: 他們現在會關心彼此生活，不只安排收件。

options.en: The lunches helped them regain a little more genuine human contact after their conversations had narrowed to arrangements.
options.zh: 交談縮窄成安排事宜後，午餐幫他們重新增加一點真切的人際交流。

options.en: They have recovered some personal conversation that their changed shifts had made less common.
options.zh: 他們恢復了一些因輪班改動而減少的個人交談。

options.en: Meeting regularly has given them a chance to reconnect beyond practical messages.
options.zh: 定期見面給他們機會，在實務訊息以外重新聯繫。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都把好處連到恢復個人交談，並不否定收件訊息的用途。

scene.promptZh: 兩位遠距朋友曾只互發節日貼圖，最近每月通話，輪流認真聽對方近況；其中一人說這恢復了少量他珍惜的交流。哪句保留這個有限評價？

options.en: The calls helped them regain a little more genuine human contact through listening to each other’s lives.
options.zh: 透過聆聽彼此生活，通話幫他們重新增加一點真切交流。

options.en: The calls show that the friends had already been discussing their lives in detail through the stickers.
options.zh: 通話顯示朋友此前已透過貼圖詳細談生活。

options.en: The friends decided to replace their monthly conversations with automated greetings.
options.zh: 朋友決定以自動問候取代每月交談。

scene.explanationZh: 真切交流可經通話出現；有互聽近況的線索，不把媒介本身定真偽。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 regain a little more genuine human contact 推出？

options.en: Some valued personal interaction has been recovered.
options.zh: 一些受重視的個人交流已恢復。

options.en: Every online relationship is less authentic than any in-person meeting.
options.zh: 每段網上關係都比任何面對面相處不真實。

options.en: The account should show what interaction had diminished.
options.zh: 敘述應交代哪種交流曾減少。

contrast.explanationZh: 此人珍惜的交流有恢復，不等於所有媒介及關係都有固定高下。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想把鄰居的午餐故事總結為「所有訊息都不算交流」，但收件訊息仍有用。哪句最合適？

options.en: They regained a little more genuine human contact by talking about their lives; the practical messages still served another purpose.
options.zh: 他們透過談生活重新增加一點真切交流；實務訊息仍有另一用途。

options.en: The main change was a better collection timetable rather than more personal conversation.
options.zh: 主要改變是收件時間表更好，不是更多個人交談。

options.en: They should replace the personal questions with delivery updates to preserve what changed.
options.zh: 要保留這次改變，他們應把個人問題換成送件更新。

dialogue.explanationZh: 分清個人交流增加及實務訊息用途，既不抹去新互動，也不貶低必要安排。

speaking.en: The shared walk helped us regain a little more genuine human contact because we took time to listen rather than only exchange arrangements.
speaking.zh: 一起散步讓我們重新增加一點真切交流，因為我們花時間聆聽，不只交換安排。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出哪種交流恢復了。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你協助一個互助小組，初期每周留時間互問近況，近月卻只讀待辦清單，個人交流減少了。今次重開自願分享環節，一位成員說終於又能講照顧家人的感受。你要寫有限度的活動回顧，保留不願分享者的選擇，不聲稱所有人都已親密。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The optional sharing time helped us regain a little more genuine human contact beyond the task list. One member could describe her feelings, while others were free simply to listen.
examples.zh: 自願分享時段幫我們在待辦清單以外重新增加一點真切交流；一位成員可描述感受，其他人則可選擇只聽。

examples.en: We began to regain a little more genuine human contact when a member spoke about caring for her family. I would keep the invitation optional rather than expect everyone to share personal details.
examples.zh: 一位成員談照顧家人時，我們開始重新增加一點真切交流；我會保留自願參與，不預期人人分享私事。

writing.selfCheckZh: 交代個人交流曾減少，再以一人的自願分享支持少量恢復；保留他人只聽及不披露私事的選擇。

takeaways.en: We hoped to regain a little more genuine human contact by leaving time for questions after the formal updates.
takeaways.zh: 我們希望在正式更新後留時間提問，重新增加一點真切的人際交流。

takeaways.en: The cousins regained a little more genuine human contact through regular calls in which both had time to speak.
takeaways.zh: 表兄弟姊妹透過讓雙方都有時間說話的定期通話，重新增加一點真切交流。

Calls can also be meaningful contact.

lessons.titleZh: 輕觸及捲動螢幕

target.pattern: \b(?:tap and scroll|tapped and scrolled|tapping and scrolling)\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Children can tap and scroll before they learn to evaluate sources.

brief.meaningEn: Perform basic touch-screen actions, selecting items and moving through displayed content.
brief.meaningZh: 做基本觸控操作，選取項目及移動查看螢幕內容。
brief.grammar: tap and scroll; tapped and scrolled; tapping and scrolling. This paired action description does not itself demonstrate evaluation or understanding.
brief.register: Ordinary paired verbs, not an idiom. Basic navigation can be useful while remaining distinct from critical judgement.
brief.boundaryZh: 會操作不等於已能判資料可信、理解內容或已提交表格；要分清觀察到哪一步。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能因操作容易便省去解釋，也不能因需要指導便否定其已有技能。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述基本操作並界定尚待核對的理解或決定。

listening.promptZh: 示範後已會甚麼，仍需甚麼協助？

options.en: They could navigate the app, but still needed support to judge the accounts’ sources.
options.zh: 他們能操作瀏覽程式，但仍需協助判斷敘述來源。

options.en: They had already identified the first-hand account without using the source notes.
options.zh: 他們未看來源註記，已找出親身敘述。

options.en: They understood the sources but could not move beyond the app’s opening screen.
options.zh: 他們理解來源，卻無法離開程式首頁。

options.en: They had only watched the demonstration and had not tried the controls themselves.
options.zh: 他們只看示範，未親自嘗試操作。

listening.explanationZh: 能瀏覽及需比來源是不同層次；不是尚未操作，也不是來源已判好。
listening.en: The visitors could tap and scroll through the archive app after a short demonstration, but when asked which account was a first-hand memory, they still needed help comparing the source notes.
listening.zh: 看過簡短示範後，訪客已能輕觸及捲動瀏覽檔案程式；但問哪份敘述是親身記憶時，仍需協助比較來源註記。

reply.promptEn: Why do the visitors still need help after using the app controls?
reply.promptZh: 已會用程式操作後，訪客為甚麼仍需協助？

options.en: Moving through the screens does not tell them which account is first-hand.
options.zh: 能瀏覽畫面，未讓他們知道哪份是親身敘述。

options.en: They can tap and scroll, but comparing the source notes is a separate skill.
options.zh: 他們會輕觸及捲動，但比較來源註記是另一技能。

options.en: They have learned navigation without yet learning how to assess those sources.
options.zh: 他們已學操作，尚未學會如何評估那些來源。

options.en: Their remaining question concerns the evidence behind the accounts, not how to move the screen.
options.zh: 餘下問題關乎敘述背後證據，不是怎移動畫面。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都回應判來源的需要，不否定已掌握的瀏覽操作。

scene.promptZh: 長者已能在活動表輕觸分類並捲到下方，卻問按「儲存」是否已報名；表上另有確認步驟。哪句準確？

options.en: She can tap and scroll through the form, but still needs the difference between saving and confirming explained.
options.zh: 她能輕觸及捲動瀏覽表格，但仍需解釋儲存與確認的分別。

options.en: She cannot reach the lower part of the form without someone moving the screen for her.
options.zh: 她無法到表格下方，需別人替她移畫面。

options.en: She has completed the separate confirmation step already.
options.zh: 她已完成另設的確認步驟。

scene.explanationZh: 已會觸控，未知提交狀態；應解釋步驟，不假定已確認。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只由能 tap and scroll 推出？

options.en: The person can perform some basic screen actions.
options.zh: 此人能做一些基本螢幕操作。

options.en: The person can already evaluate the reliability of everything displayed.
options.zh: 此人已能評估所有顯示內容的可信程度。

options.en: More information is needed to judge understanding of the content.
options.zh: 要判斷是否理解內容，仍需更多資料。

contrast.explanationZh: 操作流暢不等於資料判斷已掌握。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說既然訪客會滑動，就可省掉來源說明，但訪客仍分不清親身及轉述。哪句最好？

options.en: They can tap and scroll; we should now explain the source notes and let them compare an example.
options.zh: 他們會輕觸及捲動；現在應解釋來源註記，讓他們比較一個例子。

options.en: We should repeat only the navigation demonstration and leave the source question unanswered.
options.zh: 我們應只重複操作示範，先不回答來源問題。

options.en: We can present their fluent navigation as proof that the first-hand account has been identified.
options.zh: 我們可把操作流暢當作已找出親身敘述的證明。

dialogue.explanationZh: 支援應對準尚未掌握的來源判斷，而非只重做已會的操作或當作已理解。

speaking.en: I could tap and scroll through the page, but I still asked how to tell an original account from a later summary.
speaking.zh: 我能輕觸及捲動瀏覽頁面，但仍問怎分原始敘述及後來總結。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清操作與理解。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你測試博物館互動地圖，參加者會操作，但小圖示沒有文字，他找不到無階梯入口。你要寫測試紀錄，描述已會的動作，再建議加清楚文字標籤及重新測路線，不把失敗歸咎使用者。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The participant could tap and scroll, but the unlabelled symbols did not help him find the step-free entrance. We should add clear labels and ask him to try the route again.
examples.zh: 參加者能輕觸及捲動，但沒文字的圖示未幫他找到無階梯入口；我們應加清楚標籤，再請他試找路線。

examples.en: Tapping and scrolling were not the problem; the map did not make the entrance clear. Let us test a labelled version rather than assume the participant needs more practice with the controls.
examples.zh: 問題不在輕觸及捲動，而是地圖沒清楚顯示入口；一起測有標籤版本，不先假定參加者需多練操作吧。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用觀察分開操作能力及路線資訊可見性，提出標籤後再測，不把找不到入口當不會操作。

takeaways.en: She tapped and scrolled until she found the booking section, then checked the date before choosing it.
takeaways.zh: 她輕觸及捲動，找到預約部分後，先核日期再選。

takeaways.en: The screen let us tap and scroll through photographs while the guide explained who had taken them.
takeaways.zh: 螢幕讓我們輕觸及捲動瀏覽照片，導賞員同時解釋誰拍的。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Basic touch-screen action pair, distinct from source evaluation and transaction status. Final is accessibility-information usability testing and design diagnosis, not another source-judgement lesson.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 提供孩子所需的能力及方法

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The course equips children with useful digital habits.

brief.meaningEn: Provide people with useful skills, knowledge or habits, as though supplying tools.
brief.meaningZh: 提供有用技能、知識或習慣，像供應工具。
brief.grammar: equip someone with skills/knowledge; equipped/equipping. The original object children may change with context; with introduces what is provided.
brief.register: Conventional figurative equip when the complement is knowledge or ability. It does not require buying devices or promise that learners already have expert mastery.
brief.boundaryZh: 要說明提供哪種能力及怎練，不把上過課直接當完全掌握或只把設備分發當技能教學。
brief.misconceptionZh: 支援提升準備程度，學員仍需嘗試、判斷及跟進。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把訓練設計連到具體技能及應用機會。

listening.promptZh: 工作坊提供的是甚麼？

options.en: Practical ways to investigate a post’s authorship and timing.
options.zh: 實際查貼文作者及時間的方法。

options.en: A list of headlines to repeat without checking their origin.
options.zh: 一列可照讀而不核來源的標題。

options.en: New devices in place of any practice with information.
options.zh: 新裝置，取代所有資料練習。

options.en: Ready-made answers to the sample posts, without children practising the checks themselves.
options.zh: 示例貼文的現成答案，孩子不用親自練核查。

listening.explanationZh: 孩子練查作者及日期，提供的是方法，不是代做往後每次判斷。
listening.en: The workshop equips children with ways to check who created a post: they practise finding the author and comparing the date with the event, rather than simply repeating the post’s headline.
listening.zh: 工作坊提供孩子核查貼文作者的方法；他們練找作者及比較日期與事件，而非只重複標題。

reply.promptEn: How does the workshop help children approach a post?
reply.promptZh: 工作坊怎幫孩子處理貼文？

options.en: It gives them a way to identify the author and check the date.
options.zh: 它給他們找作者及核日期的方法。

options.en: It equips children with checking habits through practice, rather than asking them to repeat the headline.
options.zh: 它透過練習提供孩子核查習慣，不只叫他們重複標題。

options.en: The exercises help them investigate where the information came from.
options.zh: 練習幫他們調查資料來自哪裏。

options.en: They practise questions that can guide their own judgement about the post.
options.zh: 他們練習能引導自己判斷貼文的問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都有具體核查方法，保留孩子自己判斷。

scene.promptZh: 新導賞員不懂遇上沒聽清的問題怎辦；培訓讓他們練請人重說、確認意思，再回答，沒有提供逐題背稿。哪句準確？

options.en: The practice equips new guides with ways to clarify a question before answering.
options.zh: 練習提供新導賞員在回答前釐清問題的方法。

options.en: The guides are given a fixed answer to recite for each possible question.
options.zh: 導賞員獲得每個可能問題都可背的固定答案。

options.en: The training focuses only on giving out microphones, without rehearsing a response.
options.zh: 培訓只分咪高峰，沒有演練回應。

scene.explanationZh: 釐清及回應是所練能力，不是只分器材或每題背稿。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 equips children with useful habits 推出？

options.en: The teaching provides habits children can use.
options.zh: 教學提供孩子可用的習慣。

options.en: Children no longer need to judge new situations for themselves.
options.zh: 孩子不再需自己判斷新情境。

options.en: Further practice may still be needed.
options.zh: 仍可能需進一步練習。

contrast.explanationZh: 提供習慣並不取代往後判斷。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把核查工作坊成效寫成孩子已不會信錯資料，但你只觀察到他們完成引導練習。哪句最好？

options.en: The session equips children with checking methods; we should describe their practice before claiming independent mastery.
options.zh: 這節課提供孩子核查方法；聲稱已能獨立掌握前，應先描述所做練習。

options.en: Completing the guided task is enough to report that they now judge unfamiliar posts independently.
options.zh: 完成引導任務已足以報告他們現在能獨立判陌生貼文。

options.en: We should describe the author-and-date exercise as device training rather than information checking.
options.zh: 我們應把作者及日期練習說成裝置操作訓練，而非資料核查。

dialogue.explanationZh: 報告限所教方法及所見練習，不越級聲稱已獨立掌握，也不改教學內容。

speaking.en: The discussion equips students with questions they can use, but they still need to apply them to the evidence in front of them.
speaking.zh: 討論提供學生可用的問題，但仍需把問題應用在眼前證據。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把提供的方法連到自主應用。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為青年義工設計迎接有不同需要訪客的練習，不能猜對方要甚麼；你想提議先練禮貌詢問、聆聽偏好及知道何時找主管，不稱一堂課已涵蓋每個需要。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The role-play can equip the volunteers with ways to ask about visitors’ preferences and listen to the answers. We should also practise when to seek a supervisor’s help.
examples.zh: 角色扮演可提供義工詢問訪客偏好及聆聽答案的方法；我們也應練何時找主管協助。

examples.en: We can equip young people with respectful questions rather than a list of assumptions about visitors. Further practice should include recognising when a request needs more support.
examples.zh: 我們可提供青年有禮的問題，而非一列對訪客的假定；後續練習應包括認出甚麼要求需更多支援。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把訓練連到詢問、聆聽及求助的做法，不替訪客猜需求，也不宣稱一課覆蓋所有需要。

takeaways.en: The rehearsal equipped us with a shared way to pause and clarify an uncertain instruction.
takeaways.zh: 排練提供我們一套共同方法，在指示不清時暫停並釐清。

takeaways.en: The introduction equips students with useful terms before they compare the two accounts themselves.
takeaways.zh: 導入提供學生有用詞彙，之後由他們自己比較兩份敘述。

lessons.titleZh: 學生之間的隔閡

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Too much screen time can become a barrier between students.

brief.meaningEn: Something that obstructs communication or connection between learners, described as a separating barrier.
brief.meaningZh: 妨礙學習者互相溝通或聯繫的因素，比作把人隔開的屏障。
brief.grammar: become/create/remove a barrier between students; describe the obstructed exchange, not a literal wall unless context actually says so.
brief.register: Conventional barrier metaphor with a learner relationship frame. A device or habit can create a problem in one arrangement without being inherently divisive.
brief.boundaryZh: 需指出誰與誰的甚麼交流受阻，不由一次觀察推所有科技都破壞關係。
brief.misconceptionZh: 移走裝置未必已解隔閡；也可改輪流分享或加入渠道。
brief.outcomeZh: 能把隔閡連到具體溝通安排，提出可觀察的改善。

listening.promptZh: 隔閡具體怎形成？

options.en: Some members could not see or discuss the changes when decisions were being made.
options.zh: 部分成員在作決定時，看不到或無法討論改動。

options.en: All members were discussing the latest plan together in the shared document.
options.zh: 所有成員正一起在共用文件討論最新計劃。

options.en: The private thread was used only to repeat decisions everyone had already discussed.
options.zh: 私訊群組只重複大家已討論的決定。

options.en: The group had delayed any decisions until the remaining members arrived.
options.zh: 小組把所有決定延至其他成員到場才作。

listening.explanationZh: 關鍵是資訊及參與渠道不對稱，不是所有人已有共同討論。
listening.en: The private message thread had become a barrier between students in the project: two members kept deciding changes there, while the others saw only the old shared plan and could not join the discussion in time.
listening.zh: 項目中的私訊群組已成學生間的隔閡；兩名成員不斷在那裏決定改動，其他人只見舊共用計劃，無法及時加入討論。

reply.promptEn: Why are some project members unable to take part in the changes?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼部分項目成員無法參與改動？

options.en: The decisions are being made in a thread they cannot see.
options.zh: 決定正在他們看不到的群組內作出。

options.en: The private discussion has become a barrier between students because the shared plan stays out of date.
options.zh: 共用計劃一直過時，所以私下討論成了學生間的隔閡。

options.en: They are left with an old version while others discuss the new arrangements elsewhere.
options.zh: 別人在其他地方談新安排，他們卻只拿到舊版。

options.en: The process leaves them without timely access to the discussion.
options.zh: 流程令他們不能及時取得討論資訊。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都說明未能及時見改動及討論，不把沉默當不願參與。

scene.promptZh: 同班同學改用同一大螢幕輪流看彼此草稿，每人可問問題，原本各看自己裝置的情況改變。哪句最不符合已描述的互動？

options.en: The shared viewing gives the students a way to discuss one another’s drafts.
options.zh: 一起觀看給學生方法討論彼此草稿。

options.en: The shared screen is a barrier between students because it prevents them from seeing each other’s work.
options.zh: 共用螢幕是學生間隔閡，因它令他們看不到彼此作品。

options.en: The change allows questions about the drafts during the activity.
options.zh: 改動讓他們在活動中問草稿問題。

scene.explanationZh: 已說能看彼此作品及提問，不能反說被阻；螢幕的作用需看使用安排。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a barrier between students 推出？

options.en: A particular factor is hindering their connection.
options.zh: 某項因素正妨礙他們聯繫。

options.en: The students must be unwilling to cooperate with each other.
options.zh: 學生必定不願互相合作。

options.en: The context should identify what exchange is obstructed.
options.zh: 情境應指出哪種交流受阻。

contrast.explanationZh: 隔閡可能來自渠道或資訊，不自行證明合作意願。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友把沒回私訊群的成員寫成不關心，但他們根本沒被加入，仍看舊計劃。哪句最好？

options.en: The restricted thread is a barrier between students; we should invite everyone into the discussion before judging their interest.
options.zh: 受限制群組是學生間隔閡；判斷興趣前，應先讓所有人加入討論。

options.en: Their silence shows that the latest changes have already been discussed with them.
options.zh: 他們沉默顯示最新改動已與他們討論。

options.en: We should keep the changes in the same private thread and ask the others to comment on the old plan.
options.zh: 我們應繼續把改動放私訊群，請其他人評舊計劃。

dialogue.explanationZh: 先提供真實參與機會，不把無法看見的討論當已共同參與。

speaking.en: The separate channels created a barrier between students until the group made the current plan visible to everyone.
speaking.zh: 不同渠道造成學生間隔閡，直到小組讓所有人看見最新計劃。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把隔閡連到實際受阻的交流。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你觀察雙人科學活動，一人熟悉所有術語，不斷直接報答案，另一人想說觀察卻找不到插話機會。你要寫給導師的建議，安排先各自描述所見，再共同核術語，不把較少說話者當沒有想法。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The rapid use of technical terms has become a barrier between students in this pair. Could each describe an observation first, before they check the terms together?
examples.zh: 這一組快速使用術語，已成學生間隔閡；可否先各自描述一項觀察，再一起核術語？

examples.en: We can reduce a barrier between learners by giving both a turn to explain what they noticed. The quieter student needs an opening to contribute, not an assumption that there is nothing to say.
examples.zh: 給兩人輪流解釋所見，可減少學習者間隔閡；較安靜的學生需發言機會，不應被假定沒話可說。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把隔閡連到術語及輪流說話安排，提先觀察再共同核詞，不把說得少當缺想法。

takeaways.en: The unfamiliar shorthand became a barrier between students until they agreed to explain it.
takeaways.zh: 陌生簡寫成了學生間隔閡，直到他們議定解釋意思。

takeaways.en: A fixed speaking order helped remove a barrier between the students who had struggled to enter the discussion.
takeaways.zh: 固定發言次序幫原本難加入討論的學生消除了一項隔閡。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Learner-relationship barrier metaphor with a concrete participation mechanism. Final technical-language and turn-taking diagnosis differs from hidden digital decisions; no claim that devices inherently divide learners.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 通向理解的橋樑

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Technology can be a bridge to learning.

brief.meaningEn: A means that helps someone approach knowledge or understanding.
brief.meaningZh: 幫助人接近知識或理解的方法。
brief.grammar: act as/become/provide a bridge to learning; identify the connection it enables and what further learning requires.
brief.register: Conventional educational bridge metaphor. An aid can create access without automatically supplying understanding or replacing the learner’s effort.
brief.boundaryZh: 可幫入門不等於已掌握；需解釋從哪種熟悉經驗或渠道連到新理解。
brief.misconceptionZh: 受歡迎或有趣本身未證理解，應看是否幫提出問題、比較或嘗試。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明學習支援的連接功能並保留後續活動。

listening.promptZh: 照片怎幫學習開始？

options.en: Familiar places led the group to ask historical questions and check dates.
options.zh: 熟悉地方引導小組問歷史問題及核日期。

options.en: The group used the photographs only as decoration and did not discuss them.
options.zh: 小組只用照片作裝飾，沒有討論。

options.en: The guide gave dates before anyone recognised the streets or asked a question.
options.zh: 未有人認出街道或提問前，導賞員已先給日期。

options.en: Recognising the streets replaced any further investigation of the market.
options.zh: 認出街道取代了對市場的進一步調查。

listening.explanationZh: 由熟悉地點走向提問及核日期，是照片連到學習的作用。
listening.en: The old market photographs became a bridge to learning for the new history group: people first recognised familiar streets, then used the images to ask why the stalls had moved, checking the dates with the guide.
listening.zh: 舊市場照片成了新歷史小組通向理解的橋樑；大家先認出熟悉街道，再用影像問攤檔為何搬遷，並與導賞員核日期。

reply.promptEn: Why were the market photographs useful to the new group?
reply.promptZh: 市場照片為甚麼對新小組有用？

options.en: The streets they recognised gave them a starting point for historical questions.
options.zh: 認得的街道給他們問歷史問題的起點。

options.en: The images became a bridge to learning by connecting familiar places with questions about change.
options.zh: 影像把熟悉地方連到變遷問題，成了通向理解的橋樑。

options.en: They could begin with something familiar before checking the dates and reasons.
options.zh: 他們可先從熟悉事物開始，再核日期及原因。

options.en: The photographs encouraged investigation rather than just recognition.
options.zh: 照片鼓勵調查，不只停在辨認。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都交代熟悉線索如何導向新問題，保留查證。

scene.promptZh: 學生先用家中量杯比較水量，再看分數圖，能說明兩個四分之一為何合成一半；老師仍讓他們做新例。哪句合適？

options.en: The measuring activity provided a bridge to learning about fractions, with further examples still to try.
options.zh: 量度活動提供通向分數理解的橋樑，仍有新例待試。

options.en: The activity was unrelated to the fraction diagram the students discussed afterwards.
options.zh: 活動與學生之後討論的分數圖無關。

options.en: The teacher stopped all work on fractions before students connected the amounts.
options.zh: 學生未把份量連起來前，老師已停止所有分數活動。

scene.explanationZh: 由具體份量連到分數圖，且仍有練習；不是只有趣無學習關連。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 a bridge to learning 推出？

options.en: An aid helps people approach new understanding.
options.zh: 一項支援幫人接近新理解。

options.en: Providing the aid guarantees independent mastery.
options.zh: 提供支援便保證獨立掌握。

options.en: The connection it creates can be explained.
options.zh: 可以解釋它所建立的聯繫。

contrast.explanationZh: 通向學習不等於學習已全部完成。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想因照片引起興趣，就刪去查日期活動，但大家正問市場為何改。哪句最好？

options.en: The photographs are a bridge to learning; let us use their questions to guide the date check rather than stop at recognition.
options.zh: 照片是通向理解的橋樑；一起用大家的問題引導核日期，不停在認出地點吧。

options.en: We should treat recognition of the street as a completed explanation of why the market changed.
options.zh: 我們應把認出街道當作已解釋市場為何改。

options.en: We should ask them to identify the familiar streets again instead of following up the questions they raised.
options.zh: 我們應請他們再認熟悉街道，不跟進他們提出的問題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 熟悉影像已引出歷史問題，應繼續核日期及原因；只把辨認當解釋，或一再辨認而不跟進，均停在起點。

speaking.en: The familiar example was a bridge to learning, but we still needed to test our explanation against a new case.
speaking.zh: 熟悉例子是通向理解的橋樑，但我們仍需用新個案測試解釋。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再分清支援連接與後續學習。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你要向新同事介紹本地手語課，想以有字幕的簡短生活故事邀他們參加入門活動，並說明故事只是起點，仍需在導師指導下練習，不把看完影片說成已會手語。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: The captioned stories can be a bridge to learning local sign language. They offer a starting point, while guided practice will help us begin using it respectfully.
examples.zh: 有字幕故事可成通向本地手語學習的橋樑；它們提供起點，而導師指導的練習會幫我們開始有禮地使用。

examples.en: Let us use the short stories as a bridge to learning, then join the introductory session to practise with a teacher. Watching the films is an invitation to begin, not a claim that we can already sign.
examples.zh: 一起用短故事作通向學習的橋樑，再參加入門活動跟老師練習；看影片是開始的邀請，不是聲稱我們已會手語。

writing.selfCheckZh: 邀請具體後續入門及導師練習，不把生活故事的接觸機會當手語能力證明。

takeaways.en: The family recipes became a bridge to learning about the places named in her grandmother’s notebook.
takeaways.zh: 家傳食譜成了通向學習的橋樑，讓她了解祖母筆記提到的地方。

takeaways.en: We hoped the model would provide a bridge to learning before students built and tested their own designs.
takeaways.zh: 我們希望模型先提供通向學習的橋樑，之後學生自行製作及測試設計。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Educational bridge image, grounded in a path from familiarity to inquiry. Final is a practical invitation into guided language learning, distinct from archival questions and a concrete-to-diagram demonstration.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 兼得兩種方式的優點

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A blended course can offer the best of both worlds.

brief.meaningEn: Enjoy important advantages of two different situations or approaches together.
brief.meaningZh: 同時享有兩種不同情況或方式的重要好處。
brief.grammar: have/get/offer/combine the best of both worlds; identify the two approaches and the benefits combined.
brief.register: Fixed favourable evaluation. It need not mean literally every benefit, no cost or a perfect compromise for everyone.
brief.boundaryZh: 要指出兩方面及各自保留的好處，不把混合本身當所有衝突已解或無任何取捨。
brief.misconceptionZh: 需看設計實際帶來甚麼，不只是把兩個標籤放一起。
brief.outcomeZh: 能以兩個具體優點支持評價，同時承認限制。

listening.promptZh: 兼得的是哪兩種好處？

options.en: Flexible preparation at home and a shared discussion, with a meeting time still needed.
options.zh: 在家彈性準備及共同討論，仍需會面時間。

options.en: A fully independent course with no shared discussion.
options.zh: 完全獨立進行、沒有共同討論的課程。

options.en: Members discuss the reading separately with the organiser, without a shared group meeting.
options.zh: 成員各自與組織者討論閱讀，沒有共同小組會面。

options.en: Notes read only during Saturday’s meeting, with no home preparation.
options.zh: 筆記只在周六會議讀，沒有在家準備。

listening.explanationZh: 在家時段彈性及互相討論是兩好處；共同時段仍有限制。
listening.en: The reading group felt it had the best of both worlds: members could read the notes at home when convenient, then meet on Saturday to question one another’s interpretations; the shared meeting still required everyone to reserve that time.
listening.zh: 讀書小組覺得兼得兩者優點；成員可在家方便時讀筆記，再於周六見面互問理解，但共同會面仍需人人預留時段。

reply.promptEn: Why does the reading group like the arrangement?
reply.promptZh: 讀書小組為甚麼喜歡這安排？

options.en: They can prepare at their own time and still discuss their interpretations together.
options.zh: 他們可自行安排準備時間，仍能一起討論理解。

options.en: They feel they have the best of both worlds: flexible reading and a shared exchange of views.
options.zh: 他們覺得兼得兩者優點：彈性閱讀及共同交流看法。

options.en: The home notes preserve flexibility while Saturday gives them a chance to question one another.
options.zh: 在家筆記保留彈性，周六則給彼此提問機會。

options.en: The design combines individual preparation with conversation rather than making them choose only one.
options.zh: 設計把個人準備及交談結合，不必只選一種。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出兩個實際好處，不聲稱無需共同時段。

scene.promptZh: 街坊書店與圖書館合作：買書讀者可與店員談選書，借書讀者可用圖書館藏本參加同一免費讀書會；活動仍限二十席。哪句有具體雙重優點？

options.en: The partnership offers the best of both worlds: personal bookselling advice and access to borrowed copies, within the session’s capacity.
options.zh: 合作兼具兩者優點：個人選書建議及借閱藏本的機會，仍受活動容量限制。

options.en: The arrangement turns the free discussion into a buyers-only event.
options.zh: 安排把免費討論改成只給買家參加。

options.en: The library copies replace any opportunity to talk with the bookseller.
options.zh: 圖書館藏本取代了與店員交談的機會。

scene.explanationZh: 有選書交流及借閱途徑，仍限席；不是借書便取消店員交流。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 the best of both worlds 推出？

options.en: Advantages of two approaches are combined.
options.zh: 兩種方式的優點被結合。

options.en: The arrangement has no limitations or trade-offs.
options.zh: 安排沒有任何限制或取捨。

options.en: The favourable judgement depends on the benefits valued in context.
options.zh: 好評取決於情境中重視的優點。

contrast.explanationZh: 兼優可仍需時段、容量或其他取捨。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說讀書小組有兩者優點，所以不需再約共同時段，但周六討論仍重要。哪句最好？

options.en: We have the best of both worlds only if we preserve both benefits, so the shared discussion still needs an agreed time.
options.zh: 要保留兩個好處才算兼得優點，所以共同討論仍需議定時間。

options.en: We can drop the shared discussion and describe the arrangement as combining the same two benefits.
options.zh: 我們可取消共同討論，仍說安排結合相同兩個好處。

options.en: Let us spend Saturday silently rereading the notes instead of sharing interpretations.
options.zh: 周六一起安靜重讀筆記，不交流理解吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 要保留互相討論便需安排時段，不是只留獨自準備或把討論改靜讀。

speaking.en: The plan offered the best of both worlds by keeping independent practice and a regular chance to ask for feedback.
speaking.zh: 計劃保留獨立練習及定期問回饋的機會，兼得兩者優點。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再指出各自保留的好處。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你協助劇團選排練方式，錄影能讓演員自看動作，現場伙伴則能即時回應節奏。你想建議短段錄影後即場試改，而非全程錄影；仍須先問演員是否同意錄及如何刪檔。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: Short recordings followed by live adjustments could give us the best of both worlds: seeing our movement and testing the timing with a partner. We should agree on recording consent and deletion before trying it.
examples.zh: 短段錄影後即場調整，可兼得兩者優點：看自己動作及與伙伴試節奏；嘗試前應議定錄影同意及刪檔安排。

examples.en: We could get the best of both worlds by reviewing a brief clip and then rehearsing the change together. That would not remove the need to ask the actors about recording and keeping the file.
examples.zh: 回看短片再一起排改動，可兼得兩者優點；這不免除詢問演員是否同意錄影及保留檔案的需要。

writing.selfCheckZh: 指出自看動作與伙伴試節奏兩好處，採短段後即場修改並保留錄影同意及資料處理。

takeaways.en: The shared studio gave her the best of both worlds: a quiet desk and colleagues nearby when she wanted advice.
takeaways.zh: 共用工作室給她兩者優點：安靜書桌，以及想問意見時就在附近的同事。

takeaways.en: We hoped the small live audience and later written comments would offer the best of both worlds for revising the scene.
takeaways.zh: 我們希望少量現場觀眾及之後書面意見，能為修改場景兼具兩者優點。

review.author: AI author source_inventory

english.evidence: Two-benefit idiom with remaining constraints. Final designs a consent-limited movement-feedback cycle, distinct from reading flexibility and a bookseller/library access partnership.

chinese.evidence: Traditional Chinese checked against English subjects, negation, tense and modality; no independent human approval claimed.

lessons.titleZh: 讓人持續認識及關注歷史

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Community stories help keep history alive.

brief.meaningEn: Maintain active awareness, interest or memory of the past.
brief.meaningZh: 維持對過去的認識、興趣或記憶。
brief.grammar: keep/kept/keeping history alive; history is personified. Explain the records, activities or retellings that sustain engagement.
brief.register: Conventional alive metaphor for continuing cultural or historical engagement, not proof that an account is accurate merely because it is memorable.
brief.boundaryZh: 持續關注與查證準確是兩個問題；不能為精彩便補不存在的記憶，也不把一種版本當唯一經驗。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可用不同渠道延續歷史興趣，保留來源、疑問及多元經歷。
brief.outcomeZh: 能提出持續接觸歷史的方法，並清楚區分證據及想像。

listening.promptZh: 系列怎兼顧歷史興趣與不確定處？

options.en: It shared memories alongside evidence and openly noted disagreements.
options.zh: 它把記憶與證據一起分享，並公開交代分歧。

options.en: It used the most dramatic memory as the final account whenever dates differed.
options.zh: 日期有分歧時，它把最戲劇化記憶當最終敘述。

options.en: It removed the residents’ voices and broadcast only the photograph dates.
options.zh: 它刪去居民聲音，只播照片日期。

options.en: It presented every disagreement as settled before listeners heard the series.
options.zh: 聽眾收聽前，它已把每項分歧說成有定論。

listening.explanationZh: 記憶使人接觸過去，並列證據及不確定處保留準確性，不靠戲劇性判真。
listening.en: The local radio series kept history alive by pairing residents’ memories with dated photographs; when the accounts disagreed, the presenter explained the uncertainty instead of choosing the most dramatic version as fact.
listening.zh: 地方電台系列把居民記憶與有日期照片並列，讓人持續認識歷史；敘述有分歧時，主持解釋不確定處，沒有把最戲劇化版本當事實。

reply.promptEn: Why was the radio series valuable to local listeners?
reply.promptZh: 電台系列為甚麼對本地聽眾有價值？

options.en: It connected residents’ recollections with records and made uncertainty visible.
options.zh: 它把居民回憶連到記錄，讓人看見不確定處。

options.en: It kept history alive through people’s memories while still showing where the evidence differed.
options.zh: 它透過人們記憶延續歷史關注，仍交代證據不一致之處。

options.en: Listeners could hear experiences from the past without being told that every detail was certain.
options.zh: 聽眾可聽過去經歷，而不被告知每項細節都確定。

options.en: The series offered engaging accounts and a clear distinction between memory and confirmed detail.
options.zh: 系列提供引人投入的敘述，並清楚分記憶及已確認細節。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都連到記憶、記錄及不確定處，不把生動等同必真。

scene.promptZh: 學校把舊操場照片放在今昔地圖旁，請校友標自己記得的位置及年份，未核年份另標「待確認」。哪句貼切？

options.en: The project helps keep history alive while leaving uncertain dates open for checking.
options.zh: 項目幫延續歷史關注，同時保留未確年份待核。

options.en: The project treats all the years recalled by alumni as already confirmed.
options.zh: 項目把校友回憶的所有年份都當作已確認。

options.en: The photographs are displayed without any invitation to connect them with memories or places.
options.zh: 照片被展示，但沒有邀人連到記憶或地方。

scene.explanationZh: 照片、地圖及校友記憶讓人參與認識過去，但未核年份仍標待確認；不是已把每項回憶年份當成定論，也不是只有展示而無參與邀請。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 keep history alive 推出？

options.en: People continue engaging with the past.
options.zh: 人們繼續接觸及關注過去。

options.en: A memorable retelling is therefore historically accurate.
options.zh: 一段令人難忘的重述因此就符合歷史。

options.en: Evidence can still be checked alongside personal memories.
options.zh: 仍可把證據與個人記憶一起核對。

contrast.explanationZh: 持續興趣與事實準確不能互相代替。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友想為電台故事加一段未有來源的戲劇對白，並當真實回憶播出。哪句最好？

options.en: We can keep history alive through the recorded memories without presenting invented dialogue as evidence.
options.zh: 我們可用已錄記憶延續歷史關注，不把虛構對白當證據。

options.en: We should replace the uncertain account with a more detailed version even though no source supports the details.
options.zh: 我們應以更詳細版本取代不確定敘述，即使沒有來源支持細節。

options.en: We can label the new dialogue as a resident’s memory because it suits the programme’s theme.
options.zh: 新對白合節目主題，所以可標為居民記憶。

dialogue.explanationZh: 真實記憶可引人投入，無來源對白不能冒作證據；若另作創作則需清楚標示。

speaking.en: The exhibition helped keep history alive by inviting people to compare the objects with the stories recorded about them.
speaking.zh: 展覽邀人把物件與所錄故事比較，幫延續歷史關注。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把參與及資料來源分清。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你接手街區歷史網站，想讓看完展覽的人每月收到一個可自行查的問題，而不是只看一次。你要寫邀請：連結已核來源，歡迎補資料，但未核投稿先標示，不保證每個記憶都準確。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: A monthly question could help keep history alive after the exhibition ends. We can link it to checked sources and invite additions, clearly marking contributions that still need verification.
examples.zh: 展覽結束後，每月一問可幫延續歷史關注；我們可連已核來源並邀補充，清楚標仍待核的投稿。

examples.en: Let us keep history alive through a continuing enquiry rather than a single visit. Readers can follow the sources and send what they remember, while unverified details remain labelled as such.
examples.zh: 一起透過持續探究，而非單次到訪，延續歷史關注；讀者可沿來源查及寄記憶，未核細節仍清楚標示。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出展後持續參與的節奏及查來源路徑，明確保留投稿待核狀態，不把每項記憶先當事實。

takeaways.en: The annual walk kept history alive by revisiting the places described in the workers’ letters.
takeaways.zh: 每年步行重訪工人書信所述地方，延續了歷史關注。

takeaways.en: Students helped keep history alive when they asked former residents about the changes shown in the maps.
takeaways.zh: 學生問舊居民地圖所示變化時，幫延續了歷史關注。

lessons.titleZh: 代代流傳

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The songs have been passed down over generations.

sources.locatorNote: Exact guide context inspected; no absent locator inferred.
sources.sentence: Grandparents pass down family stories.

brief.meaningEn: Transmit knowledge, practices or possessions from older generations to younger ones over time.
brief.meaningZh: 隨時間把知識、做法或物品從較年長一代傳給較年輕一代。
brief.grammar: be passed down over/through generations; pass something down to someone is the broader separable pattern. This lesson focuses on intergenerational transmission. Bare grandparents pass down family stories and passive stories are passed down use the same transmission unit; explicit objects may also occur between pass and down.
brief.register: Common phrasal pattern. Transmission may include change, interrupted knowledge or variant versions; it does not prove unchanged form or a single origin.
brief.boundaryZh: 代代流傳不等於一字不改、人人都知道或只屬一種版本；具體來源及改動仍可查問。
brief.misconceptionZh: 長輩傳授不使內容免於比較，也不等於上級向下發布命令的語境。
brief.outcomeZh: 能描述跨代傳承並謹慎交代已知版本及不確定部分。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: Pass down describes transmission from older people to younger people. Over or through generations makes the time span explicit; omitting that phrase does not change the transmission sense. Passive and separable forms still need a clear thing being passed on.

listening.promptZh: 流傳與版本差異是甚麼關係？

options.en: The advice crossed generations, while the different entries still needed context.
options.zh: 建議跨代流傳，不同項目仍需背景解釋。

options.en: The notebook confirmed that every generation used exactly the same planting dates.
options.zh: 筆記確認每一代都用完全相同種植日期。

options.en: The grandchildren had already followed every date before asking about the seasons.
options.zh: 孫輩問季節前，已照每個日期做。

options.en: The family first encountered the advice from a new commercial leaflet that day.
options.zh: 家族當天才首次從新商業單張接觸那建議。

listening.explanationZh: 跨代與版本需解釋可並存，不保證日期都同或未問便做。
listening.en: The planting advice had been passed down over generations in the family, but the notebook showed different dates beside the same crop; the grandchildren asked which season each entry described before following it.
listening.zh: 種植建議在家族代代流傳，但筆記中同一作物旁有不同日期；孫輩先問各項記哪個季節，再決定照做。

reply.promptEn: Why did the grandchildren ask about the seasons before using the advice?
reply.promptZh: 孫輩用建議前，為甚麼先問季節？

options.en: The notebook gave different dates for the same crop, so the context mattered.
options.zh: 筆記給同一作物不同日期，所以背景重要。

options.en: The advice had been passed down over generations, but they still needed to understand the different entries.
options.zh: 建議雖代代流傳，他們仍需理解不同記項。

options.en: They wanted to know which conditions the inherited guidance referred to.
options.zh: 他們想知道傳下來指引指哪些條件。

options.en: They were checking the entries rather than assuming one date fitted every season.
options.zh: 他們正核記項，不假定一個日期適用每季。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都以筆記日期差異作理由，不把傳承當免查背景。

scene.promptZh: 家族聚會展示三代人的織物，各代保留同一圖案中心，邊框卻不同，並解釋誰作過改動。哪句準確？

options.en: The pattern has been passed down through generations, with changes recorded in the borders.
options.zh: 圖案跨代流傳，邊框留有改動記錄。

options.en: The different borders show that the younger generation had never seen the family pattern.
options.zh: 邊框不同顯示年輕一代從沒見過家族圖案。

options.en: The display presents every textile as an unchanged copy made by the same person.
options.zh: 展示把每幅織物說成同一人作的原樣複本。

scene.explanationZh: 共同中心及已解釋改動，支持傳承中有變化，不是毫無關連或完全不改。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜由 passed down over generations 推出？

options.en: Something has been transmitted across generations.
options.zh: 某事物跨代傳承。

options.en: Its form and meaning have remained entirely unchanged.
options.zh: 形式及意思一直完全不變。

options.en: More context may be needed to understand the version received.
options.zh: 理解所得版本，仍可能需更多背景。

contrast.explanationZh: 流傳說明傳遞，不自行保證所有版本相同。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴想把筆記印成「古老建議不用再問」，但同一作物有不同日期。哪句最好？

options.en: The advice was passed down over generations; we should preserve the entries and ask about their conditions before presenting one as the rule.
options.zh: 建議代代流傳；應保留各記項並問所用條件，再把某項列成規則。

options.en: We should remove the differing dates and print a single unqualified rule.
options.zh: 我們應刪不同日期，印一條不附條件的規則。

options.en: We should describe the advice as newly invented because the entries differ.
options.zh: 記項有分歧，所以應說建議是新發明。

dialogue.explanationZh: 保留傳承及版本背景，既不抹差異，也不把有差異當沒有傳承。

speaking.en: The story was passed down over generations, and each teller explained where their version came from.
speaking.zh: 故事代代流傳，每位講述者都解釋自己的版本來自哪裏。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再保留傳承及版本來源。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為青年展覽寫一件家傳木工具的標牌，家人知道祖父傳給母親，母親再傳給你，但不知更早製作者；你想說它跨代流傳，記下兩次已知交接，邀家人補資料，不擅定古老起源。用一至兩句英文表達。

examples.en: This tool has been passed down over generations, from my grandfather to my mother and then to me. We can record those known transfers while asking the family about its earlier maker.
examples.zh: 這工具代代流傳，由祖父傳母親，再傳給我；我們可記已知交接，並向家人查較早製作者。

examples.en: The tool was passed down through generations, but its maker is still unknown. Our label should name the family members we know received it and leave the earlier history open to further evidence.
examples.zh: 工具跨代流傳，但製作者仍未知；標牌應列已知收取它的家人，保留更早歷史待更多證據。

writing.selfCheckZh: 把兩次已知家族交接與未知製作者分清，邀補證據，不由跨代傳承推很古老或確知起源。

takeaways.en: The recipe was passed down over generations, although each cook noted small changes beside the ingredients.
takeaways.zh: 食譜代代流傳，但每位廚師都在材料旁記小改動。

takeaways.en: The craft skills were passed down through generations before the family began recording the lessons on film.
takeaways.zh: 家族開始拍片記教學前，手藝已代代流傳。
